references.text: Concerns the priests' portion of the offering, which they were to have as their food, corresponding to the principle that the Levites shall receive an equal share of the provisions.
Describes the inheritance portion of the Levites and that they are to live from the offerings given to the Lord.
Explains that the Levites shall not have any inheritance in the land, but shall live from the tithe that Israel gives.
King Hezekiah commands that the people give their share to the priests and Levites so that they may devote themselves to the law of the Lord.
Mentions the Levites' right to the tithe and how they were to distribute it among themselves.
Notes that the priests received money from their acquaintances, which may relate to 'the sale from the fathers' mentioned in Deuteronomy 18:8.
